summary: A voice channel that Nora failed to join no longer stays stuck as a served guild in /health.
details: A failed join is dropped the moment it fails, with no need for a retry — /health's guilds list stops naming it immediately.
limitations: If the guild had been connected before (connected, then a voice-death, then a later join on the same guild that also failed), any event still queued for delivery to nora from that earlier session keeps retrying in the background even after the core is dropped — no event is lost, but a fresh core minted for that guild afterward starts /voice/status's last_event_seq and outbox_dropped back at 0, so those two counters are not continuous across the discard.
